How it works & privacy +

Hold one gesture steady for a moment, with your palm facing the camera. Keep your entire hand visible in good light. Thumb position is ignored for the finger count. Use the shape buttons whenever you prefer.

Camera access begins only after permission. Frames are processed locally, never recorded or uploaded by this app. Enabling tracking downloads MediaPipe code and its model from external CDNs. Stop camera to release access. Requires HTTPS or localhost.
